research_question: Does the strongest publicly reported XAUUSD Inside-Bar continuation structure—high-directionality Main Bar plus compact Inside Bar—produce positive frozen 30-second executable persistence on January Stage-A?

source_basis.role: Open-source EA grammar: fully contained Signal Bar; Main Bar direction determines Buy Stop above Main high / Sell Stop below Main low; one position/pending order.
XAUUSD research: strongest disclosed relation around Main Bar body ~80% of total range and Signal Bar size ~50% of Main range; ATR filter less influential; XAUUSD remained reasonably strong on M15.

17CK_XIBC_M15_BODY80_INSIDE50.pattern: Main Bar then fully contained Inside/Signal Bar
17CK_XIBC_M15_BODY80_INSIDE50.direction: Main Bar close > open => long; close < open => short
17CK_XIBC_M15_BODY80_INSIDE50.breakout: Long first Ask >= Main high + $0.01; short first Bid <= Main low - $0.01
17CK_XIBC_M15_BODY80_INSIDE50.expiry: one signal timeframe bar after Signal Bar closes
17CK_XIBC_M15_BODY80_INSIDE50.rationale: Bound stale-pending influence and preserve impulse-pullback-continuation interpretation.

17CL_XIBC_H1_BODY80_INSIDE50.expiry: one H1 bar after Signal Bar closes

gate.advance_if: At least one lane satisfies all gates unchanged.

anti_overfit: No body threshold change after result
No inside-size threshold change after result
No timeframe rescue beyond fixed M15/H1 lanes
